description: Deterministic source rules for Industrial UI Modernizer. These rules flag objective or high-signal source patterns; they do not replace runtime or visual review.

rules.message: Avoid transition-all; transition only properties that are intentionally animated.
rules.rationale: Broad transitions create accidental motion and make interaction behavior harder to reason about.
rules.suggestion: List the specific properties that should transition.

rules.message: Pure black is a design-system smell in operational UI.
rules.rationale: Semantic text/surface tokens make theming and hierarchy easier to control.
rules.suggestion: Use the product's semantic text or surface token unless pure black is explicitly required.

rules.message: Generic gray bypasses semantic color roles.
rules.rationale: Operational UI needs predictable primary, secondary, muted, disabled, and status text roles.

rules.message: Large fixed pixel width can turn the application shell into a desktop canvas.
rules.rationale: Primary layouts should reflow across supported viewports.
rules.suggestion: Use responsive grid/flex constraints and a deliberate max-width only when justified.

rules.message: 100vh can be unsafe for mobile browser chrome and nested application shells.
rules.rationale: Viewport units can clip content on mobile and inside embedded shells.
rules.suggestion: Prefer modern dynamic viewport units or content-driven sizing when appropriate.

rules.message: Hidden overflow may conceal a layout defect or inaccessible content.
rules.rationale: Clipping is often used as a patch for incorrect responsive geometry.
rules.suggestion: Confirm the clipping is intentional and no essential content/focus indicator is lost.

rules.message: Extreme z-index suggests unmanaged elevation layers.
rules.rationale: Large arbitrary z-index values create stacking-context conflicts across reusable components.

rules.message: Inline style object detected in JSX/TSX.
rules.rationale: Repeated inline visual values bypass reusable tokens and component variants.
rules.suggestion: Move stable styling to the design-system layer; retain inline style only for genuinely dynamic values.

rules.rationale: Pointer-only div/span interactions commonly lose keyboard and native button/link behavior.
rules.suggestion: Use a button/link or provide the complete semantic keyboard contract when a native element cannot be used.

rules.rationale: Removing the browser focus indicator without a replacement can make keyboard navigation invisible.
rules.suggestion: Provide a visible focus-visible style before suppressing the default outline.

rules.rationale: Operational density should come from structure and spacing, not unreadably small type.
rules.suggestion: Use the documented dense-text token and verify legibility at the target display.

rules.message: Very small arbitrary text size detected.
rules.rationale: Arbitrary micro-type is difficult to govern and often harms scanability.
Operational interfaces should not make users wait for decorative motion.
rules.suggestion: Shorten the motion or document why the longer duration communicates essential state.

rules.rationale: Images need an accessible text alternative or an explicit empty alt when decorative.
rules.suggestion: Add meaningful alt text, or alt="" for a confirmed decorative image.

rules.rationale: The framework should consume the product typography token rather than silently choosing a generic AI-default font.
rules.suggestion: Use the product font token; keep Inter only when it is an intentional documented choice.
